title: Aerospace corporations hold UAP knowledge shielded from FOIA

tellings.quote: aerospace corporations have knowledge in the uap area that specifically are sequestered by against foia because of proprietary appreciables which the whole thing was set up to be that way

plain: A physicist named Hal Puthoff, who has worked on government research projects, says private aerospace companies hold knowledge about UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects. He says that knowledge is kept out of reach of FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, because it counts as company property, and that the system was deliberately set up that way.
